assessment: The Obelisco de Buenos Aires opened a regularly ticketed observation deck in November 2025. Its own entry, hours and sales make Mirador Obelisco a standalone attraction, distinct from simply viewing the public monument from the square.

observations.address: Plaza de la República, Avenida 9 de Julio y Avenida Corrientes, San Nicolás, Buenos Aires
observations.hours: Sun–Wed 09:00–21:00; Thu–Sat 09:00–23:45, per city tourism office checked 27 Nov 2026.
observations.accessibility: City tourism office states eight steps before the lift and thirty-five more spiral steps to the deck. It expressly says the visit is not accessible to wheelchair users or those with reduced mobility.
observations.weatherPolicy: City office states rescheduling/refund in force majeure such as demonstrations or bad weather.

scopeNotes: Official city tourism information was checked on 27 Nov 2026 and last modified on 24 Aug 2026. The operator booking domain returned HTTP 503 during research; booking availability and displayed price should be confirmed again before travel.
